reviews.text: Nice staff and quick for vaccinations
These people are angels.  Hard-working, efficient, and they took exceptional care of our little furry friend

A nightmare. My cat received a sterilization tattoo on his stomach (where ink is inserted in an incision that is closed with surgical glue). It opened up and the vet at PAWS felt absolutely no urgency to see my cat immediately, causing me to have to seek care elsewhere and subsequently not get a refund. He ended up needing staples and antibiotics from an emergency clinic. So much for hearing its "no big deal" from PAWS.
Excellent for helping you with your pets .

What a wonderful resource for Philadelphia cat owners! I was able to get my brother’s cat spayed at no cost to him. The staff at PAWS were so caring and helpful. The whole visit, drop off and pick up was so easy. They also microchipped his cat, cut her nails, and gave her a rabies vaccine  and necessary vaccines. This was all included! Amazing resource as my brother is disabled. I am so grateful for the work PAWS does for our communities.
My second time bringing our furry family member , as usual the staff is amazing , my animals come home happy. Im bringing in my third furry family member next week.
This was my first time going to PAWS when I took both of my male kittens to get neutered last week. The staff were very welcoming, nice and give you full details of everything you need to know.
So far, everything about PAWS is great except getting there. Traffic is always awful.

Parking needs improvement.
Service is great.

PAWS is awesome. I had my cats spayed/neutered there. You can get shots and general veterinary care in addition to spraying/meowing. The prices are so much better than a regular vet that you can afford to get your pets the kind of care they deserve rather than having to choose between taking him/her to the vet or eating that week. The care is exceptional and the staff is friendly, knowledgeable, professional and compassionate. I recommend PAWS to every pet parent I know.

We took our 4 month old kitten here to be neutered. The staff was friendly and efficient. I was pleasantly surprised to be able to enter the building and check in my pet before 8am as the other PAWS facility makes customers wait in a line outside until after 8am. The staff at Grays Ferry was awesome and I will be returning here for my pet needs from now on.

They were very welcoming and took good care of our kittens. I definitely recommend this place! They did find fleas on them and treated it as much as possible for a small fee , very thankful for their care.
Reasonable, friendly, and professional. No complaints.
Quick easy kind
I needed to surrender some kittens. Alley and staff made it as easy as could be for something so hard.
Flea treatment was very inexpensive for both dog & cat. In and out didn't have to bring pets only needed weight.
Absolutely nothing but the best.

They always & I mean always take good care of my animals, today nova got an abortion & their care was top notch💜 10/10 would recommend thank you to all the staff for making this crazy situation a wonderful experience, thank yu …

Friendly Staff
Appointments required
Affordable services.

Clean environment. Staff communicates clearly about expectations but is very kind in doing so. I will be returning tomorrow to have a Mother and two kittens spayed/neutered. They qualified for the no-cost program and I couldn't be happier. A clinic truly worth every donation. Thanks PAWS!!!
Always great service!!
They did a great job with my cat Mrs Puggles! Very affordable but always booked so keep checking their website for open appointments. Mrs Puggles is back to her normal self the moment we got home.

truly want to leave this review because I’ve had such a wonderful experience with this clinic. From the very first time I brought one of my cats, they treated us with so much kindness, patience, and care. You can genuinely tell they love what they do and truly care about the well-being of the animals.

I’ve now taken two of my cats there, and both times I felt calm, heard, and well guided. They always take the time to explain everything in detail and answer all my questions without rushing, which I really appreciate as a pet owner.

I fully trust them with the care of my babies and I recommend them with complete confidence. It’s not easy to find a place that makes you feel this safe, and this clinic absolutely does.
Great people,  Great service,  great price
Amazing community resource for affordable pet care. Great quality of care and extremely kind and caring staff. Having this clinic in the neighborhood is a blessing.
They are so very caring when it comes to helping your animals. The spay process is so very easy to understand & the pricing is beyond reasonable! Great staff too!!!
I always take my dog there because of the care she gets. I didn’t add photos cause they don’t want anyone taking any while there.
This place makes it possible for many people who can't afford it otherwise to get their animals fixed. ♥️

I would like to thank the outreach community manager, Allison. I have four dogs and two three cats. I was laid off recently and have been going through some financial troubles, Allison was able to get me the help that I needed for for me to keep my babies.

I have now lived behind this location for 2.5 yrs and have done exactly as instructed to get an appointment however; I have never been contacted and have even visited the location in person and told each time to call and use e web portal and yet not one call or email has ever been received from them. I have had three friends try and they have one difference they are not in the minority. It is extremely unlikely that all of my recorded calls over this time have been “overlooked”. I am going back with hidden camera and mic to get to the bottom of this and see why they are treating a retired vet with such ignorance. All I wanted to do was have my dog and cat serviced ie shots and claws and whatever services I can get since it is in proximity to my home but I am at a loss as to why I see many people and even one new resident behind them get appointments and yet I still get no calls. The portal that I have checked every day for two months never has any open appointments when I check yet the new neighbor was able to walk in and schedule
Amazing!!!!

Definitely racist, me and my friend went and my friend is white and Italian and I'm Indian American. My friend had no wait time they called her by her name and they didn't ID her when we were told to have identification on hand. When I went in they were very unwelcoming and disengaging , I did have to wait in the lobby, when I was call it was by my first initial only and it was very unclear if I was being spoken to , the dog food they gave us where very different in brand quality and quantity with more than a $25 differents in product. And I was not givin access to the same inventory that my friend was. On the way out the man at the desk said something very discouraging and belittling as this was a free pet food gave away. And just for some background they emailed me to participate in the give away.
Paws is a great place to adopt pets. I have adopt a beautiful cat that is very cute.
Amazing what this place does.

Can’t believe all these people who left reviews actually got a damn appointment! I’ve been calling for a YEAR leaving voicemail after voicemail. What’s the point in having a business that can’t handle the load and then doesn’t communicate effectively when they can’t
Amazing an caring employees, from the front desk to the vet. Non judgemental surrender.

This is the best vet office ever, in my opinion. From the first phone call to picking up my cats, my overall experience was phenomenal. The customer service was excellent. The ladies at the desk were really great. And you definitely can't beat the prices of this wonderful place. I don't usually write reviews but this place left a really great impression. I plan on bringing my 3rd cat here once he's old enough to go. They did an excellent job as well on my cats, salt and pepper.

So far, the best spay and neuter clinic in the city. I managed to get my entire cat family (one mom, 3 boy kittens and two girl kittens) fixed and vaccinated for under $500. The staff really cares and will make sure you're taken care of.

Friendly, timely and affordable. My cats were itching feverishly but didn't have fleas. Paws and they discovered ear mites. With the solution they prescribed gave relief to my cats immediately and life is almost back to normal..

I can't say enough good stuff about this Paws  location the staff are true animal lovers the the care that my dog Oreo received here was above and beyond any veterinarian I have taken her to and the time they take with you the owner is Way beyond what I expected of any clinic I highly recommend this is a top-notch facility

PAWS is a great place to adopt, get professional advice it care for your furry family members.  They've helped me by taking a sick wild bird, a feral animal in need of help & spaying my cat, Joy.  Philly's fortunate to have this organization & it's 'humane' resources. Call or email ahead to assure you'll be seen, as soon as possible, They accept donations, to help continue their hard work.
I enjoyed the simplicity of everything. The direction was clear. How to care for my cat at home was clear. Over all a good experience. Thank you
Had pretty good luck with them one rescue did return unspayed however good service
Great Work! My Kitten is doing much better then how she was. We will be back for a Follow Up! 😇👌 …
Lately they never have any appointments and it's sad.... They give you numbers to other vets who prices are so high.
Very understanding work staff. I booked at a different location they right a way said if you don't mind waiting we will fit u in didn't even wait 10 minutes thank you PAWS.
I had my female pup spayed and they performed a wonderful service and I’m glad to say hats off to Paws!
"I LOVE MY PAWS LOCATION., THE STAFF IS AWESOME ALSO"!!!

I Love This Place, Very Attentive To Your Animals Needs. I Went In With My Yorkie & Had No Idea when His Tail Got Caught In The Door As He Entered & I Let Go, I Examined & Treated His Tail With Witch Hazel & Neosporin To Lessen Any Pain,,,That The Damn Door Took The Tip Of His Tail Off & It Was Dangling and I Washed Him Up Pryor to His Appointment.  When They Administered his Annual Shots & He Was Fidgeting, it Made His Tail Bleed and I Was Wondering Where The Blood Was Coming From. I Told Them What Happened Weeks Ago & They Gave Me A List Of Emergency Care Animal Hospitals To Take Him & Helped Me Stop The Bleeding. I Was Very Grateful & That Was Extremely Helpful👍🏾💙🐶
Wonderful care for your pets at affordable prices.

I was nervous when I took my cat to get neutered.  I waited in the parking lot because I was falling apart.  When I walked in the staff was soothing.  Thank you.  I gave my cat over to a Paws staff and r left slowly out the door. Only to wait for my call.  Calling Paws. I flew out the door to pick up my cat.  I was giving instructions how to take care of my cat.  The staff was sooo pleasant and understanding to a cat parent.
An amazing service for all the pets and owners!

I love the convenience of this location and the prices are soooo affordable which I appreciate. They were able to provide a fast urgent dewormer and vaccination appointment for my puppy Maestro when I first got him and he had worms. The worms came back as they warned the eggs could hatch at a later date. I emailed for another appointment and booked after receiving a response a few days later. I mistakenly went in early than the appointment date I booked by accident and they were able to accommodate me which I truly appreciate. The only reason for losing one star is because during the first appointment, I had no idea that you could bring home fleas from this facility which actually happened, and I had to go out and purchase flea products, vacuum everything, wash everything. That was scary because it was so unexpected. I would think they would have some kind of preventative measures in place to ensure new customers wouldn't experience that. I keep my puppy in a carrier instead of having him on a leash now because I am afraid of having a repeat experience. But the staff are great, I still go here and I would recommend.
Very nice and helpful staff
We love this place!!!  Very Pet friendly,!!!!

Paws has always been great. The doctors that I’ve encountered have been very patient and understanding. I also appreciate how they slow down and break things down so you can understand what’s wrong with your pet. It’s hard to get in but so worth the wait.
They took great care of my cat. They included us in his treatment. The staff are very friendly and helpful 😸 …
Paws 🐾 is the best animal hospital in the world.  Caring people that works there. They care for the animals. Natalie smith is the best and I really appreciate her. …
I was not able to walk in with an injured stray cat I found on the street. Referred to north philly animal shelter.

Have to call my lawyer because they gave me the wrong cat TWICE. Don’t bring your animals here they tried giving me a female cat first then a cat that weighs twice as much as my kitten the second time. Still don’t have my daughters cat

The staff here are friendly, fast and efficient. I have enjoyed my two experiences with the vaccination clinic.

The only downside is the appointment scheduling is inconvenient. Slots open up for only (1) week at at time. It was a challenge to get in to reserve a spot to keep my kitten's vaccination series current. Most appointments are in the middle day during the week. I work so far away that it would cause me to miss almost an entire day at work. I  lucked out the 1st time with a last-minute Saturday cancelation. The 2nd time, I had an unexpected day off, which enabled me to take Paisely in during normal work hours.
I couldn't get an appointment for her 3rd shot. I had to transition elsewhere to a full services veternarian.

If you have job flexibility, or are retired, etc., this is a awesome place, at a reasonable cost with great staff! Recommend!
I’ve been donating old towels and blankets for the animals for years. The staff is always so kind!

I had my rescue services here - the staff does not answer the phones and they do not return business calls in a timely fashion as their voicemail says.

The only method of communication is email. They have an auto generated email saying they’ll get back to you if there’s an appointment. When there is an appointment the staff emails you back and forth for sometimes days because they don’t know how to collect all of the information at once. If you’re late they charge fees and don’t offer any grace even if you are coming from a distance. They offer different rescues different fees. Because I was late a few times with about 6 cats because I am a single woman who runs her rescue they retaliated and dropped my rescue pricing. All of this while I have a letter of reference from their vets.

Go here if you have the time and patience to deal with retaliation , rude staff, email
Communications for scheduling appointments. Otherwise there are better places that care for low income communities and don’t treat you like your scum.

If you can get in- book it! Warm, friendly, and the lowest prices ANYWHERE! We found an abandoned stray kitten last month under our stairwell at midnight and desperately needed to bring him somewhere low cost to get vaccines ASAP. After doing some quick research, I found PAWS and booked an appointment immediately to get him in. We had to wait 2 days for the appointment, but for the money you will save, it's worth the wait.

Once we were there, it was super quick- we were in and out in less than 30 minutes- and everyone was so incredibly kind and helpful. They confirmed for us that he was a stray (not microchipped) and went ahead with administering the vaccines we requested along with testing him for FIV and FELV. His results fortunately came back negative and he now has a new forever home with 2 siblings :)

Thank you so much PAWS!!
Timely service and pleasant staff
Respectful and very helpful organization.

I couldn’t believe what I was seeing watch two people let their cats go right out front. They said the staff couldn’t give them their vaccinations. Unbelievable. I tried to catch the cats but I couldn’t    so sad!
They were really kind.  Clearly they love what they do.

Wish they had better information. We went there because my cat was in critical condition and wasn’t to sure what to do, they sent us to a place in Jersey that couldn’t do anything to help and we had to make the choice to put our cat down instead of them sending us to a place that could help him.

Very helpful.Welcoming environment with employees that have good bedside manners.  And always made sure I had extra syringes for the medicine and even provided me for free a box of churros.

My cat passed away at 14 due to oral cancer. Jake, I'll never stop loving you ❤️
Good service

Absolutely amazing clinic! Going here is even better than going to the vet. If there's anything you should double check with a vet, they let you know. FYI: My favorite vet service to use when I need to speak to a vet is Chewy's FREE online chat.

Thank you so much to everyone here for everything you do and for truly caring for animals and the people who own them. Being a pet owner is hard enough without having to worry about paying outrageously high vet bills you can't afford. Seriously, thank you so much! You really do make the world a better place :)

I have NOTHING but Great and notable things to say about this business, the services and their staff!!! Hands DOWN the most efficient, pleasant and affordable experience you’ll ever have for your pet! There are mostly women who work at this location but THEY ALL demonstrate exceptional genuineness, care & compassion! I wish I could list them by name and ONLY IF you can get an appointment in, then you too will be IMPRESSED by the level of hospitality!
Thank you PAWS for being here!
Great Customer ❤️❤️

They diagnosed my cat with cancer, but never called back to confirm whether it made it's way to her lungs or not. They said they would call back with the results. They never did.

After almost two months of trying to reach out to them and get an answer to that question, they finally sent a email recently telling me they are too understaffed to perform any surgeries. They effectively just killed my cat due to their tardiness. I could have went somewhere else & had her life saved in this time. Don't come here unless you want your animals to die. These people obviously don't give a damn.
Great place and the people are all sweethearts and truly love animals. Prices are fantastic!!

I went there to get my cat her shots and the people who worked there were Awesome and the staff were outstanding and I would recommend anyone who can't afford help for there animals to please go there!
On the 6th feral basement kitty dropped off for a TNR.  Great service, took great care of her.  Spay, vaccinations, flea treatment.  Wonderful job.
Quick & good quality service!
The service was great they had my dog in and out in 20 minutes

They really helped money wise getting my puppy spayed, get shots and a chip put in.
All for under 70.00 bucks!
They try to help if you can't afford the medical bills.
The staff took care of my baby, Fancy! Forever grateful! 🙏🏾💯 …
Had 3 strays fixed staff is always friendly..highly recommend

So convenient and affordable
Great service
This place is a blessing
